function settleWinningTicket(uint256 ticketId) external override nonReentrant returns (uint256 cashAmount) {
        cashAmount = _settleWinningTicket(ticketId);
evidence.role: Permissionless settlement entrypoint with no actor-specific gate.
Settlement records only internal outcome and accounting state.
Redemption checks the current owner and burns the claim.
NFT delivery failure or failed ownership verification reverts.
Cash delivery rejects failed token transfers.
Inherited burn consumes the ERC-721 claim.

3 hits: standalone settlement call, inline redemption call, and private definition.
0 hits for transfer, safe, ownerOf, balanceOf, call, delegatecall, or staticcall; only two member invocations, both internal Math.mulDiv calls.
1 hit: msg.sender appears only as WinningTicketSettled event data.
2 hits: implementation and interface declaration; no wrapper or other in-scope caller.
3 hits: redemption, refund, and the inherited ERC721 definition; no alternate winning-claim burn path.
0 hits; delivery failures are not swallowed.

reasoning: Both NftWon and CashWon settlement branches validate the winning range and only allocate internal liabilities. Every redemption combination—already settled or inline-settled—then checks live ERC-721 ownership, burns in the same invocation, and leaves NFT or cash delivery failures uncaught so all preceding effects revert. No uncovered branch makes the result partial, and the additional reentrancy and ownership-verification checks support rather than materially strengthen the specified invariant.
